name: io.github.emilkrebs/med-research-mcp
title: Med Research MCP
description: Evidence-graded literature search: PubMed, Europe PMC, ChinaXiv, RussiaRxiv with study-design tiers.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact email sent with NCBI E-utilities requests; falls back to the project's registered contact when unset.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NCBI API key; raises the rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/second.

environmentVariables.name: MED_RESEARCH_UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact email for Unpaywall open-access lookups; falls back to NCBI_EMAIL, then the project contact.

environmentVariables.name: MED_RESEARCH_PROXY_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: EZproxy-style DOI prefix for institutional full-text access, e.g. https://doi-org.ezproxy.your-university.edu.
